text: Every clause MUST come from the requirement text; NEVER invent a behaviour, value, role, message, state or limit the text does not state.
checklist: Each clause states only behaviour, values, roles, messages, states and limits that the requirement text states.

text: Every clause MUST be one line in the form "AC-n. Given ..., when ..., then ..." with one behaviour and one observable result.
checklist: Each clause is one line with Given, when and then once each, one action and one result a person can observe.

text: Every clause MUST end with an italic source phrase copied word for word from the requirement text.
checklist: Each clause ends with an italic source phrase that is found in the requirement text by search.

text: Clause ids MUST run AC-1 to AC-N in one run across all headings.
checklist: The ids run AC-1 to AC-N with no gap, repeat or restart at a heading.

text: A heading MUST appear only when the text supports at least one clause under it.
checklist: Every heading above Open questions has at least one clause, and no heading is empty.

text: Only a gap that BLOCKS a clause MUST become a [blocking] question that starts with its heading name and ends with Blocks: and the clause id or quoted source phrase it blocks; blocking questions come first, have no fixed cap, and NEVER suggest an answer, an example or a value.
checklist: Every [blocking] question starts with a heading name, ends with Blocks: and an existing clause id or a source phrase found in the requirement text, and holds no suggested answer, example or value; none is cut to reach a number.

text: A vague word in the text MUST become the blocking question What measurable value defines "<word>" for <thing>?; NEVER a clause and NEVER a made-up number or unit.
checklist: Each vague word has the [blocking] measurable-value question, no clause is built on it, and no number or unit is added.

text: Out of scope MUST list only what the text itself excludes, each with its source phrase; otherwise it reads None stated.
checklist: Every Out of scope line has a source phrase from the requirement text, or the section reads None stated.

text: With no requirement text, or a title only, the skill MUST reply with the exact sentence of layer 03 and NEVER write a clause.
checklist: With no requirement text or only a title, the reply is the exact sentence and holds no clause and no heading.

text: NEVER write test code, a regression checklist, a screen design, rewritten copy, an estimate or a priority; the exact sentences of layer 06 MUST be used.
checklist: A request outside the boundary got the exact sentence of layer 06 and none of the refused work.

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md.
The skill MUST be self-contained; NEVER name a repository path in SKILL.md, layers or references.
SKILL.md MUST stay within 150 lines and have frontmatter with name, description and semver version.
Every relative link MUST point to a file inside the skill folder.

Every other question MUST be tagged [minor], merged into at most three lines of at most two questions each after the blocking ones, or dropped when it only restates a default; a question that blocks nothing is NEVER tagged [blocking].
checklist: Minor questions are tagged [minor], appear after all [blocking] questions in at most three lines of two questions at most, and none only restates a default.

text: For a multi-screen or multi-step feature, the document MUST include a compact Flow & State Table (| Step | User does | System shows (loading / empty / error / success) | Next or exit |) followed by one line each for Entry point:, Exit:, Reload:, and Permissions:, quoting only stated facts and marking unstated cells TBD (see Open questions); single-screen stories omit the table.
checklist: Multi-screen or multi-step specs include the Flow & State Table and the four summary lines with no invented states; single-screen stories omit the table.

text: When docs/foundation/product.md or docs/foundation/domain.md exist in the project (or are provided in the prompt), read them by reference for stated users and domain rules; treat any (fill me) line as unknown under Open questions (or Needs a decision), NEVER as a rule.
checklist: Stated foundation facts are used without invention, and any (fill me) line is flagged as unknown under Open questions rather than turned into a rule.
